```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(fpp3)
library(gt)
```

## Data import / preparation

```{r}
# aggregate into Purpose
data("tourism")
data <- tourism |>
  group_by(Purpose) |>
  summarise(Trips = sum(Trips)) 

#create training cutoff date and split data
train_cutoff <- yearquarter("2017 Jan 01")
```

## Tab1 - Visualization

## Data visualization

Inputs 

*multiselect for Purpose
*Date range
  *First date is the Train date cutoff - default to 1 year
  *Second date is the end of the forecast horizon - default to last date

```{r}
#visualize the data with autoplot by purpose
data_train <- data |>
  filter(Quarter < train_cutoff)

data |>
  autoplot(Trips) +
  labs(y = "Trips", title = "Tourism data") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(train_cutoff), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Purpose, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal()
 
```

## Tab 2 - Model Building

* Inputs:
* Toggle for model specification (default off)
* Toggle training accuracy (default off)

### Model fitting

Build multiple models for the Purpose using Auto ARIMA and ETS
```{r}
fit <- data_train |>
  model(
    arima = ARIMA(Trips),
    ets = ETS(Trips)
  )
fit # output the model specifications
```


## Training accuracy

```{r}
fit |>
  accuracy() |>
  select(Purpose, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |>
  arrange(.model, MAPE) |>
  gt() |> fmt_number(
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  tab_header(title = "Training Accuracy") |>
  tab_source_note("Source: Tourism data")
```

### Forecast accuracy

```{r}
fc <- fit |>
  forecast(h = "1 year")
fc |>
  accuracy(data) |>
  select(Purpose, .model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |>
  arrange(.model, MAPE) |>
  gt() |> fmt_number(
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  tab_header(title = "Forecast Accuracy") |>
  tab_source_note("Source: Tourism data")
```

## Tab3 - Forecast

* Inputs:

* Select the model for the Forecast Table

### Forecast visualization


```{r}
train_start <- yearquarter(train_cutoff |> as.Date() - years(2) )
fc |>
  autoplot(data |> filter(Quarter >= train_start)) +
  labs(y = "Trips", title = "Tourism data forecasts") +
  facet_wrap(Purpose ~ .model, ncol = 2) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Report generation


```{r}
fc |>
  filter(.model == 'arima') |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Purpose, .model, Quarter, .mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = .mean) |>
  gt() |> fmt_number(decimals = 0)
```
